scripts.backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run setup:backend
